# BTS 7960 Standoff (third-party)

- Author: DubstepOwl
- Source: https://www.printables.com/model/655891-bts-7960-standoff
- License: CC BY 4.0 (attribution). Unmodified copy, downloaded 2026-11-06.

Measured: 47 x 47 mm footprint, 39 mm tall (Y is up in the file, so rotate it upright in the slicer).
Four posts on a 40 x 40 mm square, matching the IBT_2 / HW-039 mounting holes. The designer says 4 mm screw holes.
